Name: Customize Dresser
Author: Dragoon23
Description:
[size=3][b]Customize Dresser[/b]

Options. Everything can be turned on/off:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Everything can be stored in Dresser. [/size]
[*][size=3]27 Categories to sort items by in the Dresser.  [/size]
[*][size=3]Can change order of Tabs. [/size]
[*][size=3]Controller support to move through tabs. Works with Furniture Catalogue tabs too.[/size]
[*][size=3]Keyboard hotkeys to move through tabs.[/size]
[*][size=3]Can Quick Stack and Favorite slots. [/size]
[*][size=3]Grid UI[/size]
[*][size=3]HoverText/Tooltips for each Tab[/size]
[*][size=3]Can Manually sort items into different tabs. Works with all modded items.[/size]
[*][size=3]Can extract single/bulk items from dresser [/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]Note: Only empty dressers/fish tanks and sling shots/fishing rods with no ammo/bait/tackle equipped will be allowed into Dresser. [/b]
[/size]
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
(Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM [/url]﻿to use the config UI.[/size]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
[size=3]Config file is generated after first launch. Default is everything on and left/right shoulder buttons for Previous/Next tab. Optional GMCM file included. Can enable/disable every category,  change the order of the tabs, and set the controller prev/next buttons. 

[/size][size=4]Default Order + Categories  + Any notes:
[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Hats [/size]
[*][size=3]Shirts [/size]
[*][size=3]Pants [/size]
[*][size=3]Boots[/size]
[*][size=3]Rings [/size]
[*][size=3]Weapons[/size]
[*][size=3]Tools - All Tools, Bombs, Totems, Horse Flute, Qi stuff[/size]
[*][size=3]Bait[/size]
[*][size=3]Tackles [/size]
[*][size=3]Fish[/size]
[*][size=3]Gems and Breakables - Gems, Geodes, Artifact Troves, Mystery Boxes, Dragon Tooth, Galaxy Soul[/size]
[*][size=3]Minerals[/size]
[*][size=3]Metal Ores - Ores, Bars, coal[/size]
[*][size=3]Building Resources and Monster Drops - Wood/Stone, Resin/Syrup/Tar, Cloth, Monster Drops[/size]
[*][size=3]Craftables - Small/Big Craftables, Fertilizer[/size]
[*][size=3]Seeds - All Seeds + Saplings[/size]
[*][size=3]Flowers - Crop and Foraged[/size]
[*][size=3]Fruits - Crop and Foraged[/size]
[*][size=3]Vegetable - Crop and Foraged[/size]
[*][size=3]Foraged Fruits, Vegetables, Mushrooms [/size]
[*][size=3]Forage Crabpot, Beach, and Roe - Crabpot, Beach Forage, Roe, Algae, Seaweed, Jellies[/size]
[*][size=3]Animal Products - Eggs, Milk, Duck Feathers, Hare's Foot, Wool, Truffles, Slime Eggs[/size]
[*][size=3]Cooked Foods and Artisan Goods[/size]
[*][size=3]Furniture - All furniture + Wallpaper[/size]
[*][size=3]Artifacts - Artifacts, Ginger Island Bones[/size]
[*][size=3]Trinkets[/size]
[*][size=3]Miscellaneous - Movie/Prize Tickets, Trash, etc. If it's not in any of the other categories, it's probably in here. Due to the way things are categorized in the game, a lot of things are sorted into here.[/size]
[/list][size=5]
How To Use Quick Stack, Favorite, Single/Bulk Extract:
[/size]
[size=3][b]To Quick Stack: [/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Open the Dresser and press the Quick Stack Key. [/size]
[*][size=3]Default is Left Trigger for Controllers and Left Control for Keyboards.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]To Favorite:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Open the Dresser, move cursor over the slot, and press the Favoriting Button. [/size]
[*][size=3]There will than be a light gray filter over the slot which indicates its been favorited. [/size]
[*][b][size=3]NOTE: This will favorite the Slot, not the item. [/size][/b]
[*][size=3]Default is Right Trigger for Controllers and Tab for Keyboard. [/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]To Single/Bulk Extract: [/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Single Item: Default is Right click for Keyboard and X button for controller to take out a single item. [/size]
[*][size=3]Bulk Extract: Default is hold Left Shift and right click for Keyboard. For controller Default is tap DPadRight to toggle Bulk Extract and use X button.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]
How To Use Manual Sort:
[/size]
[size=3][b]To Manual Sort: [/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Open the Dresser and select the Tab. [/size]
[*][size=3]Move cursor over item from your inventory that you want manually sorted into tab.[/size]
[*][size=3]Click Manual Sort button. Default is G for Keyboard and DPadDown for Controller.[/size]
[*][size=3]Works with all modded items.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]To Select a Different tab: [/b]
[/size][list][size=3][/size][*][size=3]To select another tab, repeat above.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]To enable Vanilla Sort: [/b]
[/size][list][size=3][/size][*][size=3]Click tab that item was manually sorted into, move cursor over item in inventory, and click Manual sort button.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Manual sorting list Save Location: [/b]
[/size][list][size=3][/size][*][size=3]CustomizeDresser/CD_ManualSortingList/CD_ManualSortingList.json[/size]
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Windows.[/size]
[*][size=3]Works in single player.[/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Should be compatible with Linux/Mac/Multiplayer but I only test for Windows/single player so can't say for sure.[/size][/size]
[*][size=3]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url], [size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33271]Compact Searchable Shop Menu[/url]﻿[/size].[/size]
[/list][size=5]

Replace the one in the assets folder with the one you want: [/size]
[list]

[*][size=3][size=3]Sakura Interface Redux[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]Starry Sky Interface[/size][/size][/size]

[*][size=3] VPR-Inspired UI[/size]
[*][size=3]Icons with No Background so it's easier to add it to whatever UI background you want. [/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166?tab=description]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url]﻿ includes it in its compatibility files under Optional Files[/size]
[/list]
